Hiring: Automation Tester | UAE

We are looking for an experienced Automation Tester to join our team and drive quality engineering across web, mobile, and API platforms.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases based on requirements
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing using automated scripts
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and retrospectives
  • Provide detailed test reports and quality metrics to stakeholders
  • Identify, document, and track defects using tools like Azure DevOps, JIRA, etc.
jobSkills: Minimum 8+ years of overall experience in automation testing
Strong hands-on experience in UI, Mobile App, and API automation
Exposure to AccelQ is an added advantage
Minimum 3+ years of experience in Website/UI and eCommerce mobile app testing (Mandatory)
Exposure to Airline domain is a plus
